description: TypeScript libraries for the Trust over IP stack: DIDs, TSP (Trust Spanning Protocol) messaging, verifiable credentials, delegation for AI agents, KERI audit logs, zero-knowledge membership, COSE and LoRa transport. Published as @toip-tools/* on npm.
rules: Install the libraries from npm as @toip-tools/<name>; they need Node 22.13 or later.
Identities are did:key from identityFromSeed or a random seed; sign documents with signDocument and verify with verifyDocument from @toip-tools/trust-core.
Send Trust Tasks with an Endpoint over a transport: Bus for in-memory tests, RelayTransport with @toip-tools/relay for real delivery.
Trust Task type URIs live under https://toip.tools/spec/<name>/<version>; declare your own with ourSpec.
Use @toip-tools/mandates to give an AI agent bounded, revocable authority; check every action with MandateEngine.decide before acting.
